headline: Spain to Have the Most Advanced Cleanroom in the Country: IMEC Begins in Málaga in 2027
summary: Spain's minister and IMEC's CEO confirmed construction of IMEC's Next-Generation Semiconductor Center at the Málaga TechPark will begin in Q1 2027, with the cleanroom to be the most advanced in the country.
why: IMEC is a Belgium-based semiconductor research institute, and its facilities are part of Europe's push to build advanced chip capabilities.
